कुंजी निष्कर्षण

The process of obtaining a cryptographic key from a hardware or software source, typically for backup, migration, or forensic analysis, requiring strict security controls.

Definition

The process of obtaining a cryptographic key from a hardware or software source, typically for backup, migration, or forensic analysis, requiring strict security controls.

Operational example

Key extraction from a hardware security module is tightly controlled and logged to prevent unauthorized access or compromise.
